name: Stoplight
description_en:
Stoplight is a platform for designing OpenAPI descriptions, documenting APIs and applying shared design standards. Teams can work with API definitions, models and Markdown explanations before or alongside backend development, then publish a developer-facing project.

The Stoplight Platform is a subscription product. Prism, Spectral and Elements are separate open-source projects for mocking, linting and documentation components; their availability does not make the full hosted platform open source. The reviewed workflow concerns design and documentation, not proof of runtime gateway enforcement.
description_zh:
Stoplight 用于设计 OpenAPI 描述、编写 API 文档及应用共享设计标准。团队可在后端开发前或同步维护接口定义、模型及 Markdown 说明，再发布开发者项目。

Stoplight Platform 是订阅产品；Prism、Spectral、Elements 分别为 mock、lint 及文档组件开源项目，不能因此把完整托管平台标为开源。已核查流程涉及设计及文档，不代表已证明运行时网关策略执行。

sections.title_en: Start with a contract and a consumer task
sections.title_zh: 从契约及消费者任务开始
sections.en: For a proposed order-status API, create a workspace and blank project, choose visibility, then create an API with a selected OpenAPI version and YAML/JSON format. Add a Markdown article covering authentication and a safe read. Review the form/code views and published result. The Quickstart also allows importing existing definitions or Git content. This prepares an interface contract and documentation; it does not create the production order service or prove that an implementation follows the specification. No project was created here.
sections.zh: 以拟建订单状态 API 为例：创建工作区及空项目、选择可见性，再指定 OpenAPI 版本和 YAML／JSON 格式创建 API。补充认证及安全读取的 Markdown 说明，检查表单／代码视图及发布结果。Quickstart 也允许导入既有定义或 Git 内容。这是在准备契约和文档，不会创建生产订单服务，也不能证明实现符合规范。本次未创建项目。

sections.title_en: A style guide must be enabled where it should apply
sections.title_zh: 规则组需要在目标项目启用
sections.en: The Style Guide Quickstart distinguishes shared public/custom guides from local project rules that cannot be shared. Shared guide workflows are marked Pro Team/Enterprise. Enable a guide on an API project, inspect Errors and follow a diagnostic into code. Creating a guide alone does not establish that every API is checked. Test a deliberate design violation and confirm scope, severity and disabled rules before treating a clean result as meaningful. Static design checks are not runtime authorization or business correctness tests.
sections.zh: Style Guide Quickstart 区分共享公共／自定义规则组与不能共享的项目本地规则，共享流程标注 Pro Team／Enterprise。应在 API 项目启用规则组，检查 Errors，并定位到代码。仅创建规则组不能证明所有 API 已被检查。需有意制造设计违规，确认范围、严重度及禁用规则，再解释干净结果；静态设计检查不是运行授权或业务正确性测试。

sections.title_en: A guide with validation errors cannot be published
sections.title_zh: 规则组校验错误会阻止发布
sections.en: The guide’s own validation errors disable its Publish button. Resolve the ruleset configuration separately from API violations, then publish and enable the intended guide. Retest an example that should fail and one that should pass. The reviewed documentation does not establish automatic rollback of a broken backend or recovery of deleted content. Keep API definition changes reviewable and verify the published view after release rather than interpreting a saved editor file as a complete deployment.
sections.zh: 规则组自身存在校验错误时，Publish 按钮会被禁用。应区分规则集配置错误与 API 违规，修正规则后再发布并启用。重新检查应失败及应通过的样例。已读文档未证明自动回滚故障后端或恢复删除内容。定义改动应可审阅，发布后核对公开视图，不能把编辑器保存当成完整部署。

sections.title_en: Visibility and editing access are separate dimensions
sections.title_zh: 可见性与编辑权限是不同维度
sections.en: Workspace roles and project roles have distinct responsibilities. New projects default to Internal: workspace members can view, while guests need direct project access. Private projects require Startup or above; Public permits anonymous access. Internal article/API markers can hide work-in-progress details from guests. Git permissions can also prevent editing; connecting a service account changes that access path. Evaluate anonymous, guest and editor views with test identities, especially before publishing a partly private API. These documentation controls do not replace backend authorization.
sections.zh: 工作区与项目角色职责不同。新项目默认 Internal，工作区成员可见，访客需直接项目权限；Private 需 Startup 及以上，Public 允许匿名访问。文章／API 内部标记可对访客隐藏开发中内容。Git 权限也可能阻止编辑，连接服务账号会改变访问路径。发布部分私有 API 前，应以测试身份核对匿名、访客及编辑者视图。文档控制不能替代后端授权。

sections.title_en: Choose hosted collaboration or a component deliberately
sections.title_zh: 明确选择托管协作或单独组件
sections.en: Hosted Studio provides a publish/share workflow. Its Quickstart describes Studio Desktop separately and says desktop projects are not automatically synchronized and published. Current desktop maintenance and supported installation versions were not verified. If the need is only an embeddable reference, standalone linter or mock/proxy, evaluate Elements, Spectral or Prism under their own licenses instead of assuming a Platform subscription is required for every component. Conversely, an open-source component does not include all hosted governance, identity or collaboration capabilities.
sections.zh: Hosted Studio 提供发布／分享流程；Quickstart 另述 Studio Desktop，并说明桌面项目不自动同步及发布。本次未核实当前桌面维护及支持安装版本。若只需嵌入参考、独立 lint 或 mock／proxy，可按各自许可评估 Elements、Spectral、Prism，不能假设每个组件均需平台订阅；同样，开源组件不包含全部托管治理、身份及协作能力。

sections.title_en: Base subscriptions include a user allowance
sections.en: The readable pricing page displays Basic $44/$56 monthly, Startup $113/$147 and Pro Team $362/$453, with annual/monthly choices. Basic includes the first three users, Startup eight and Pro Team fifteen; additional-user figures are $11/$14 for Basic/Startup and $22/$27 for Pro Team. Because flattened content shows both cycles, confirm the selected cycle and checkout amount rather than treating the lower number as cancel-anytime monthly. Enterprise is a quote. The listed trial is 14 days; it does not establish sustained free use of paid tiers.
sections.zh: 可读定价页同时显示年付／月付选项：Basic 月均 $44／$56、Startup $113／$147、Pro Team $362／$453。分别含前三、八、十五用户；Basic／Startup 额外用户列 $11／$14，Pro Team 列 $22／$27。扁平正文同时展示两周期，需核对实际选择及结算金额，不能把低数字视为随时取消的月付。Enterprise 询价；试用十四天，不代表付费层持续免费。

sections.title_en: Platform entitlement follows a commercial subscription
sections.title_zh: 平台权限遵循商业订阅
sections.en: The published subscription agreement grants limited, non-transferable internal use for paid users and treats licensed materials as proprietary. An actual order or quote can set customer-specific terms. The open-source page separately presents community projects, so the platform is not classified under a component’s license. For evaluation, inventory required seats, private projects, shared style guides, Git provider and documentation visibility. Performance, UI languages, exact support entitlement and actual failure recovery were not tested.
sections.zh: 已公布订阅协议授予付费用户有限、不可转让的内部使用权，并将许可材料视为专有；实际订单或报价可能设客户具体条款。开源页另列社区项目，因此不按组件许可分类完整平台。评估时应列席位、私有项目、共享规则、Git 提供方及文档可见性；性能、界面语言、具体支持权益及故障恢复未实测。
